# DSH Studio v0.9.2

这是一个针对 v0.9.1 的 Harness 启动可靠性修复版本。它解决 Windows Profile 中的官方模块链接
偶发无法遍历时，重启或等待仍可能无法恢复的问题。

## 新增

- **Studio 自有的 Harness 模块解析器。** 启动时会为托管运行时原子补齐一个受控解析器，避免
  Profile 依赖上游为每个官方包创建的单独 Junction 才能启动。
- **真实 Profile 故障注入验收。** 发布门禁会验证解析优先级和第三方隔离，并在持续移除本次报告
  涉及的 4 个官方模块链接时运行真实 Profile 启动与 HTTP 健康检查。

## 变更与安全

- 正常的 Profile 模块解析始终优先；只有 Node 明确报告缺失、且包名属于官方
  `@deepseek-ai/*` 范围时，才回退到已验证的 Studio 托管 Harness。
- 第三方插件不会经过该回退路径。插件缺失、无权限、版本不兼容和配置错误仍保留原始错误，避免
  用托管运行时意外替代用户选择的插件。
- 解析器文件会经过真实目录、受控路径和内容校验后原子写入；不信任符号链接，也不扩大 Profile
  对原生能力的访问范围。

## 修复与打磨

- 修复 Windows 安装或升级后偶发出现
  `the managed Harness modules remained unavailable after automatic recovery`，并伴随
  `Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/…' imported from …\.dsh\profiles\web` 的启动失败。
- 修复仅增加有界等待仍依赖同一组易失 Junction 的问题；现在即使这些链接在启动期间消失，官方
  模块也可直接从已验证的托管 Harness 解析。
- 保留原有的有界启动重试作为最后防线，并继续在失败时提供简短、可操作的恢复提示。

## 安装与更新

v0.9.2 支持从 v0.9.1 原位升级。现有 `~/.dsh` Profile、第三方插件、工作区、会话和凭据不会被
删除或重写；升级后的首次启动会自动补齐解析器，无需手动清理 Profile 或 Harness。

本版本在 Windows 11 上使用真实用户 Profile 完成了连续 10 次故障注入启动与 HTTP 健康检查，
并通过完整发布测试、原生 Release 构建和跨平台 CI。当前没有 Apple 真机；macOS Intel、Apple
Silicon 与 Universal 资产会经过编译、单元测试、完整运行时 headless 启动和更新签名检查，但不
宣称完成 Gatekeeper、VoiceOver 或安装器真机人工验收。系统发布者签名状态以最终公开资产核验
结果为准。

[英文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.9.2/CHANGELOG.md) · [中文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.9.2/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md) · [比较 v0.9.1...v0.9.2](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/compare/v0.9.1...v0.9.2)

<!-- dsh-notes:en -->
# DSH Studio v0.9.2

This Harness startup reliability release fixes an intermittent Windows failure where official modules imported from
a Profile remained unavailable even after v0.9.1's bounded automatic recovery.

## Added

- **Studio-owned Harness module resolver.** Studio atomically materializes a controlled resolver in the managed
  runtime, so startup no longer depends on every upstream per-package Junction remaining traversable.
- **Real-Profile fault-injection acceptance.** Release tests verify resolution priority and third-party isolation,
  then boot a real Profile while repeatedly removing the four official module links from the reported failure.

## Changed and secured

- Normal Profile resolution remains first. Fallback is limited to an actual `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for an official
  `@deepseek-ai/*` import and resolves only against the qualified Studio-managed Harness.
- Third-party packages never use this fallback. Missing, unauthorized, incompatible or misconfigured plugins retain
  their original error instead of being substituted from the managed runtime.
- The resolver is atomically repaired only after real-directory, controlled-path and content validation; unsafe links
  are refused.

## Fixed and polished

- Fixed intermittent `the managed Harness modules remained unavailable after automatic recovery` and
  `Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/…' imported from …\.dsh\profiles\web` startup failures after install or upgrade.
- Removed the retry-only dependency on the same transient Junction set while retaining bounded startup retry as a
  final defense and preserving concise recovery guidance.

## Install and update

Version 0.9.2 is an in-place upgrade from v0.9.1. Existing `~/.dsh` Profiles, third-party plugins, workspaces,
sessions and credentials are preserved. The resolver is added automatically on first launch; no manual Profile or
Harness cleanup is required.

Windows 11 validation covered ten consecutive real-Profile boots and HTTP health checks under continuous fault
injection, the full release gate, a native Release build and cross-platform CI. No Apple device is currently
available; macOS Intel, Apple Silicon and Universal assets are compiled, unit-tested, headless-booted with the full
runtime and updater-signature checked, but Gatekeeper, VoiceOver and installer flows are not claimed as physical-device
validated. OS publisher-signing status depends on final public-asset inspection.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.9.2/CHANGELOG.md) · [中文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.9.2/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md) · [Compare v0.9.1...v0.9.2](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/compare/v0.9.1...v0.9.2)
